news.headline: Inside the London hacker house taking a stand against founder burnout
news.summary: A London founder house is experimenting with a radical idea: what if work-life balance actually prevented burnout instead of just sounding nice in mission statements? The collective is putting structure around downtime and mental health as core operating principles rather than afterthoughts, betting that founders who aren't running on fumes make better decisions and build stronger companies. It's a direct challenge to the hustle-culture playbook that's defined tech for decades.

news.headline: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
news.summary: A startup is selling a $9 NFC key that forces you to physically scan it every time you want to access your phone's most addictive apps. The hardware-based approach sidesteps typical digital willpower by adding a friction layer between you and the apps designed to keep you scrolling. It's a throwback to the pre-smartphone era of self-control—except you're literally holding the key.

educational.title: What Is Diversification, Really?
points: Diversification means spreading money across many assets, not just many stocks
It won't stop losses, but it stops one bad bet from wiping you out
Owning 10 tech stocks isn't diversified — that's still one sector's risk
True diversification spans asset classes: stocks, bonds, cash, real estate
The goal isn't more returns — it's smoother, more survivable ones
